text:
Leah: Morning team — kicking off Harboron onboarding. Main goals: 1) integrate Redwood API for embeddings + chat, 2) enable Harboron ops with the Console dashboards, 3) get a renewal health signal by +60d. Meeting invite sent for Thu Apr 24 09:00 PT. Alex (Harboron) will join.

Dmitri: Thanks — quick Q: who owns model mapping & initial evals?

Priya: I can own model mapping. Plan: run evals against their support transcripts. Timeline: baseline eval by week 1, quality gate by week 3.

Jonas: I'll own dashboard onboarding & tracing hooks. I need PR/console access from Harboron — do we have the SSO admin contact?

Leah: Alex gave SSO owner as Alex (Harboron) — I'll DM them for admin access. Action: Leah -> request SSO; Priya -> share eval prompt set.

Amir: For renewal risk: flagging two premium seats they may confirm by day 30. Suggest an exec check-in at day 45 to surface any commercial risks.

onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: "Harboron Kickoff" — Thu Apr 24 09:00 PT (https://calendar.redwood/evt/12345).

Dmitri: Ops question: what's their expected traffic profile? need this to size Dedicated vs Hosted recommendation.

Leah: Harboron expects ~5k reqs/day with short bursts during support hours. Recommendation: start on Hosted for dev, then pilot Dedicated if sustained throughput >2k rps or lower tail latency needed. I'll add a cost/throughput estimate to the doc.

Priya: Draft prompt set uploaded: https://redwood.docs/harboron/onboard/promptset — I'll run the baseline eval Thursday and share results.

Jonas: Enablement plan idea: three sessions — 1) Developer intro (week 1), 2) Admin + SSO (week 2), 3) SLA & runbook review (week 3). Who will schedule these?

Leah: I'll schedule developer intro & admin training. Amir can schedule the exec check. Priya can schedule the quality review.

Dmitri: Risks to call out now: SSO timing, token scopes for their proxies, and data retention policy differences. Add these to the risk register.

Leah: Added to risk register. Also plan to capture feedback via a 3-question survey after week 2. Draft email template: ```Hi Alex — quick 3-question check-in: 1) Any integration blockers so far? 2) Is the docs flow clear? 3) Any early wins to highlight? Thanks, Leah```

Priya: :thumbsup:

Amir: Proposed success criteria (short): a) API integration complete with test traffic, b) Console shows token/cost breakdown per route, c) 95th percentile latency < 400ms for main customer-facing route, d) exec sentiment >= "likely" for renewal.

Leah: Nice — I'll add those into kickoff notes and share with Alex before the meeting. Any blockers before we proceed with the invite?

Jonas: Need a list of sample logs/headers for tracing integration (X-Request-ID, X-User-ID, latency-ms). Priya can attach that to the enablement materials.

Priya: Uploading sample logs now to the doc folder.

Leah: Follow-ups recap: Leah -> DM Alex for SSO (today), Priya -> baseline eval (by Thu EOD), Jonas -> publish enablement calendar (by Fri), Amir -> create day-45 exec-check reminder.

Amir: I'll add the reminder and tag the commercial lead. Marking renewal risk as "monitor" for now.

Leah: :wave: Thanks all — I'll post the public kickoff doc after the meeting and ping this thread with links to notes & recordings.

Dmitri: Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
